---
name: Bug report
about: Something in the game is broken or behaves unexpectedly
title: "[Bug] "
labels: bug
assignees: ''
---

**Describe the bug**
A clear, concise description of what's wrong.

**To reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior, as precise as you can make them (which
biome, which hat/frame, which keys pressed).

**Expected behavior**
What you expected to happen instead.

**Screenshots / video**
If applicable, add screenshots or a short clip.

**Build info**
- Version / build id (shown on the title screen, or in the archive filename)
- Platform: [Windows / Linux / Web]
- If web: browser + whether it's embedded on itch or opened standalone

**Save file**
If the bug is reproducible from a specific save, consider attaching it
(check it doesn't contain anything you don't want to share — saves are plain
JSON, so you can open it first to check).

**Additional context**
Anything else relevant — did this start after a specific update, does it
happen every time or intermittently, etc.
